Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class FixedSpeedControlResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.FixedSpeedControlResult
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class FixedSpeedControlResult extends Object implements Serializable
Outcome of CompressorFixedSpeedControl.evaluate(Compressor, double): how a constant-speed compressor member meets a required discharge pressure and what that costs.

A constant-speed machine (electric motor on a fixed gear, no variable-speed drive) cannot change rpm. Its chart gives a fixed head at each flow, so the discharge pressure is controlled by moving the operating point along the curve: recycle raises the through-flow and lowers the head, a throttle burns the surplus head, and a head shortfall cannot be recovered at all. This result classifies the case, gives the controlled operating point (through-flow, recycle fraction, shaft power and discharge temperature at the real head) and the margins to the surge control line and the stonewall limit.

  • Constructor Details

    • FixedSpeedControlResult

      public FixedSpeedControlResult(String memberName, FixedSpeedControlResult.Status status, double speedRpm, double requiredDischargeBara, double deliverableDischargeBara, double processFlowM3PerHr, double throughFlowM3PerHr, double recycleFraction, double surgeControlFlowM3PerHr, double stoneWallFlowM3PerHr, double throttlePressureDropBar, double shaftPowerKW, double dischargeTemperatureC, double polytropicEfficiency, String message)
      Constructor.
      Parameters:
      memberName - compressor name
      status - how the requirement is met
      speedRpm - fixed member speed in rpm
      requiredDischargeBara - required discharge pressure in bara
      deliverableDischargeBara - highest discharge pressure the chart reaches at the fixed speed without recycling below the surge control line (the pressure at the process flow, or at the control-line flow if that is higher), in bara
      processFlowM3PerHr - actual inlet flow of the process in m3/hr
      throughFlowM3PerHr - actual flow through the machine at the controlled operating point (process flow plus recycle) in m3/hr
      recycleFraction - recycle share of the through-flow, 0 to 1
      surgeControlFlowM3PerHr - flow of the anti-surge control line at this speed in m3/hr (0 if unknown)
      stoneWallFlowM3PerHr - stonewall flow at this speed in m3/hr (NaN if unknown)
      throttlePressureDropBar - discharge pressure that has to be throttled away at the controlled point, in bar
      shaftPowerKW - shaft power at the controlled operating point (through-flow at the real chart head) in kW
      dischargeTemperatureC - machine discharge temperature at the controlled operating point in C
      polytropicEfficiency - chart polytropic efficiency at the controlled operating point (0 to 1)
      message - short explanation
